# Square Faction — royal relics and bonus ending

- Original source: [Square Faction — royal relics and bonus ending](https://squarefaction.ru/game/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/articles/6167-korolevskie-relikvii)
- Author / publication: XmasC00kie / Square Faction
- Language / date: Russian; 2012-04-01
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

An illustrated Russian collectible guide with item descriptions, locations, and associated Prince John dialogue. It covers the sceptre, Domesday Book, coronation spoon, Silver Arrow, Sword of State, ampulla, seal, and crown.

The author explicitly distinguishes the Silver Arrow from royal regalia while asserting it is nevertheless necessary for the bonus ending. That distinction matters: seven score-bearing royal items and eight ending collectibles are compatible claims, not necessarily a contradiction.

The guide describes the bonus as a return to Sherwood after Richard's final cinematic, followed by a celebratory dance involving Robin, Marian, and the companions. It also explains dialogue-dependent item access and the beggar/scroll sequence leading to the crown.

**Limitations:** the ending requirements and pickup conditions are community observations, not independently tested here. Preserve the distinction between scoring and ending checks when using this source for verification.
